features.name: credit_amount_log_scaled
features.description: Log-scaled requested credit size using training-fold min and max amount.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths skewed monetary scale and keeps large requests comparable for a linear margin.

features.name: duration_scaled
features.description: Normalized loan term using training-fold duration limits.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures term length on a bounded axis so the SVM can weight longer commitments smoothly.

features.name: amount_duration_intensity_log_scaled
features.description: Log-scaled requested amount per month, bounded by ratio limits implied by training-fold amount and duration limits.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an amount-per-period view that distinguishes short expensive borrowing from longer moderate borrowing.

features.name: installment_share_scaled
features.description: Installment commitment normalized from its 1 to 4 ordinal scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents repayment share as a smooth burden axis rather than raw levels.

features.name: repayment_pressure_composite
features.description: Weighted burden index blending term, installment share, and log amount.
features.expected_model_benefit: Pre-combines size, term, and installment intensity into a near-linear strain direction.

features.name: checking_liquidity_gap_score
features.description: Cash-account shortfall score from checking_status; higher values indicate weaker immediate liquidity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts account-status buckets into an ordinal cash-buffer axis, reducing sparse dummy dependence.

features.name: savings_gap_score
features.description: Reserve shortfall score from savings_status; higher values indicate thinner savings cushion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a monotone reserve signal from savings buckets.

features.name: employment_instability_score
features.description: Work-tenure instability score from employment; higher values indicate less stable employment history.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies an ordered work-continuity axis more compact than separate category indicators.

features.name: credit_history_concern_score
features.description: Ordinal concern score from credit_history; higher values mark delays or thin/fully settled records, lower values mark established paid records.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms prior record states into a compact concern direction useful with limited rows.
features.formula: np.where(credit_history == 'critical/other existing credit', 0.15, np.where(credit_history == 'existing paid', 0.25, np.where(credit_history == 'all paid', 0.60, np.where(credit_history == 'no credits/all paid', 0.70, 0.85))))

features.name: asset_housing_support_score
features.description: Combined support score from property_magnitude and housing; higher values indicate stronger asset backing and more stable housing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a normalized support axis that can offset pure burden features in a linear margin.
features.formula: np.clip(0.70 * np.where(property_magnitude == 'real estate', 1.0, np.where(property_magnitude == 'life insurance', 0.75, np.where(property_magnitude == 'car', 0.55, 0.15))) + 0.30 * np.where(housing == 'own', 0.85, np.where(housing == 'rent', 0.45, 0.35)), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: purpose_discretion_judgment
features.description: Semantic 0 to 1 score using only purpose: 0 means essential or productive use such as repairs, retraining, education, or business; 1 means more discretionary consumption such as radio/tv or a new car; intermediate values cover mixed asset purchases.
features.expected_model_benefit: Introduces a common-sense ordering of purposes that one-hot encodings may represent inefficiently with only 300 rows.

features.name: obligation_support_complexity_judgment
features.description: Semantic 0 to 1 assessment from existing_credits, other_payment_plans, other_parties, num_dependents, job, and housing: 0 means simple obligations with clear support and stable work context; 1 means many simultaneous obligations, weak support, or capacity concerns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an approximate linear projection of interacting burden and support cues without fitting any supervised mapping.
